message:
So in `mrb_str_len_to_integer`, when overflow occurs, it calls `mrb_bint_new_str(mrb, p2, p3-p2, sign ? base : -base)`. Here `p2` points to the digits (after the sign), and `p3` is advanced past valid digits. So `p2` doesn't include `-`.

Let me look at `mrb_cstr_to_inum` which is called from `mrb_str_to_inum`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "mrb_cstr_to_inum" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/string.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
